source: Qwen3.6-27B. Shapes DERIVED FROM THE REAL Qwen3.6-27B config.json (linear_num_value_heads=48, linear_num_key_heads=16 pre-broadcast to Nv=48 by repeat_interleave, head_k_dim=head_v_dim=128) for the same two call sites that fire in Qwen3_5GatedDeltaNet.forward (16-token prefill + decode). NOTE: shapes are config-derived (verified against config.json), NOT captured from a live 27B forward (the 27B weights are too large to probe on this box); the call structure is identical to the 3.5 capture, only the head count differs. Input tensor VALUES are synthetic.
description: Two paths fire in Qwen3_5GatedDeltaNet.forward (line 510 / 522): recurrent path on decode (seq_len==1, has cache), chunk path on prefill or chunked-decode. Qwen3.6-27B config: num_v_heads=48, num_k_heads=16, head_k_dim=head_v_dim=128 (q/k already broadcast to Nv=48 by repeat_interleave). g is fp32 (forced by .float() on A_log + softplus). use_qk_l2norm_in_kernel=True so the op pre-normalizes q,k internally. initial_state for recurrent comes from the cache as bf16; last_recurrent_state output is always fp32. End-to-end gate: bf16-realistic (atol 5e-2, rtol 1e-2) for fused outputs; --strict mode promotes to fp32 and gates at 3e-3.

test_cases.description: decode path: recurrent_gated_delta_rule with seq_len=1 and cached state, 240 calls per 6-token greedy run (48 linear layers x 5 decode tokens)
prefill path: chunk_gated_delta_rule with seq_len=16, no initial state, 48 calls (1 per linear layer per prefill)
